parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan.

parameters.name: BackupSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup set.

parameters.name: BackupSetStatus
parameters.description: The status of the backup set. You can use this parameter to filter backup sets.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A token that you can use to ensure the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- 30

- 50

- 100

Default value: 30.

parameters.name: ShowProgress
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return real-time information about the backup progress.

parameters.name: ShowStorageType
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the storage type of the backup set.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
